name: rating-inline
title: Rating inline
description: Stars drawn to the exact average, the score and the review count in one line, linking to the reviews, for product titles and cards.
docs: Give it the average and the count; a count of zero shows emptyText ("No reviews yet"), or nothing with emptyText={null}. With href the whole line is a link. Pass label to translate the sentence a screen reader hears. To collect a rating use the Rating primitive.
